$comment: All times are UTC. anchorDate: null = still to be confirmed; those events are skipped with a warning until filled in.

phaseCycle.$comment: Context only — these weeks are never announced. anchorWeekStart must be the Monday that begins a Confluence week; it exists solely so Altar of Trial can be suppressed during Battle of Disorder weeks.

events.name: Gathering Speed-up Skill
events.$comment: Every non-Confluence week (both Disorder weeks and Destiny): Sunday morning.

events.name: Altar of Trial
events.$comment: Quiet through the Disorder weeks except their final day, the Sunday that ends the second one.

events.name: Alliance Showdown
events.$comment: Every other Thursday, on the weeks Joint Competition does not run.

events.name: Battle of Lost Shrine
events.$comment: Every other Sunday. anchorDate must be a Sunday; the code rejects it otherwise.

events.name: Joint Competition
events.$comment: Every other Monday, aligned with the phase-cycle week boundary.
